<!--
  The form of AuthCard: the fields of the mode (sign-in, sign-up, reset, magic link), remember me and the forgot
  link, the terms, the submit button.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { AuthLabels } from "../blocks/auth-card.types";

export type AuthFormProps = {
  id: string;
  mode?: "signin" | "signup" | "reset" | "magic";
  labels: AuthLabels;
  submit: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from "../primitives/button/button.vue";
import Checkbox from "../primitives/checkbox/checkbox.vue";
import Form from "../primitives/form/form.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Input from "../primitives/input/input.vue";
import Label from "../primitives/label/label.vue";
import Link from "../primitives/link/link.vue";
import Field from "../components/field.vue";
import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

const { id, mode = "signin", labels, submit } = defineProps<AuthFormProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Form method="dialog" class="gap-4" data-testid="auth-form">
    <Field v-if="((mode as string) === 'signup')" :label="labels.name" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-name', id)">
      <Input type="text" name="name" autocomplete="name" :id="tpl('{0}-name', id)" data-testid="field" />
    </Field>
    <Field :label="labels.email" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-email', id)">
      <Input type="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" :id="tpl('{0}-email', id)" data-testid="field" />
    </Field>
    <Field
      v-if="(((mode as string) !== 'reset') && ((mode as string) !== 'magic'))"
      :label="labels.password"
      :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-password', id)"
    >
      <Input
        type="password"
        name="password"
        :autocomplete="(((mode as string) === 'signup') ? 'new-password' : 'current-password')"
        :id="tpl('{0}-password', id)"
        data-testid="field"
      />
    </Field>
    <Group v-if="((mode as string) === 'signin')" justify="between" align="center" class="flex-wrap gap-2">
      <Group gap="2" align="center" :class="cn('w-fit', '')">
        <Checkbox name="remember" :id="tpl('{0}-remember', id)" />
        <Label :for="tpl('{0}-remember', id)" class="text-sm">
          {{ labels.remember }}
        </Label>
      </Group>
      <Link href="#/" variant="default" class="text-sm">
        {{ labels.forgot }}
      </Link>
    </Group>
    <Group v-if="((mode as string) === 'signup')" gap="2" align="center" :class="cn('w-fit', '')">
      <Checkbox name="terms" :id="tpl('{0}-terms', id)" />
      <Label :for="tpl('{0}-terms', id)" class="text-sm">
        {{ labels.terms }}
      </Label>
    </Group>
    <Button variant="default" size="default" type="submit" class="w-full" data-testid="submit">
      {{ submit }}
    </Button>
  </Form>
</template>
